learning_outcomes.description: Understand Workplace Health and Safety Regulations

performance_criteria.description: Explain key OHS legislation and regulations relevant to the IT sector.
Identify the roles and responsibilities of individuals and organizations in maintaining a safe work environment
Describe the process for reporting health and safety risks and incidents.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify Workplace Hazards and Implement Control Measures

performance_criteria.description: Identify common hazards in IT work environments, including electrical, ergonomic, and data-related risks
Assess the severity and likelihood of potential hazards in specific IT tasks.
Implement appropriate control measures, such as safe cabling practices, ergonomic workstation setup, and electrical safety protocols.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply Emergency Procedures and First Aid in the Workplace

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the correct procedure for responding to workplace emergencies, such as electrical fires or equipment malfunctions.
Perform basic first aid techniques, including treating minor injuries and using first aid equipment
Communicate and coordinate effectively with emergency services and other relevant personnel during a workplace incident.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the Roles and Responsibilities within a Team

performance_criteria.description: Identify the different roles and functions within an IT team (e.g., network engineers, system administrators, software developers).
Describe the key responsibilities and contributions of each team member.
Recognize the importance of each role in achieving the team's objectives.

learning_outcomes.description: Foster Positive Working Relationships within a Team

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate techniques for effective interpersonal communication and conflict resolution in a team environment.
Show the ability to provide constructive feedback and actively listen to others' contributions
Promote inclusivity and collaboration among team members to ensure participation and engagement from all.

learning_outcomes.description: Contribute to Team Problem-Solving and Decision-Making

performance_criteria.description: Participate in group discussions to identify and analyse IT-related problems.
Suggest innovative solutions and support team decision-making processes.
Evaluate the effectiveness of team decisions and propose improvements where necessary.

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate Technical Information Clearly and Accurately

performance_criteria.description: Explain IT concepts, procedures, and solutions in a manner appropriate to the audience, whether technical or non-technical.
Use industry-standard terminology correctly when describing technical processes
Adapt communication methods to suit the context, such as written reports, emails, or verbal presentations.

learning_outcomes.description: Utilize Digital Communication Tools Effectively

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate proficiency in using digital tools for communication, such as email, messaging platforms, and collaboration software (e.g., Slack, Teams).
Adhere to best practices for professional digital communication, including email etiquette and secure file sharing.
Use collaborative tools to share and receive feedback on documents, code, or project updates.

learning_outcomes.description: Listen and Respond Appropriately in a Professional Context

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate active listening skills during team discussions or client meetings.
Respond to questions, concerns, and feedback clearly and effectively.
Clarify misunderstandings and summarize discussions to ensure mutual understanding.

learning_outcomes.description: Know IoT and its importance in today’s technology landscape

performance_criteria.description: Define Internet of Things (IoT)
Explain Importance of IoT in industries such as healthcare, manufacturing, smart cities, etc.
Identify components of IoT ecosystem: Devices, communication, and cloud

learning_outcomes.description: Know Key IoT Terms and Concepts

performance_criteria.description: Explain basic IoT concepts, such as machine-to-machine communication and data acquisition
Use terms like "edge computing," "smart devices," and "big data" in context
Identify different IoT platforms available e.g., Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, etc

learning_outcomes.description: Know development boards

performance_criteria.description: Discuss Unity Board (Arduino-compatible) as a development board
State Features and technical specifications
Explain the differences and similarities between the Unity Board (Arduino Compatible) and other Development Boards.

learning_outcomes.description: Get Started with an IDE

performance_criteria.description: Set up the Integrated Development Environment (IDE installation)
Configure the Unity Board in an IDE
Upload a code (Hello World)

learning_outcomes.description: Know Sensors and Actuators

performance_criteria.description: Identify sensors (temperature, humidity, light, motion, etc.)
Identify actuators (LEDs, buzzers, relays, motors)
Explain how sensors and actuators interact with the development boards (Unity Board, Arduino, ESP32 etc)

learning_outcomes.description: Learn Wiring and Connections

performance_criteria.description: Do Basic Breadboarding
Use Common electronic components (resistors, capacitors, transistors)
Connect sensors and actuators to the Unity Board (Arduino-compatible)

learning_outcomes.description: Know Basic Circuit Design and Simulation

performance_criteria.description: Do basic Circuit Analysis
Use Proteus etc for circuit simulation
Design simple IoT circuits (LED control, buzzer alarm)

learning_outcomes.description: Know Programming Basics

performance_criteria.description: Explain C/C++ application in embedded systems
Explain the structure/algorithm of an embedded program (Arduino IDE etc)
Discuss data types, variables, and operators

learning_outcomes.description: Read Digital Input/Output signals

performance_criteria.description: Identify digital pins on the Unity Board (Arduino-compatible)
Control LEDs with digital output
Read button presses (digital input)

learning_outcomes.description: Read Analog Input/Output Signals

performance_criteria.description: Identify analog pins on the Unity Board (Arduino-compatible)
Read data from analog sensors (e.g., potentiometer, temperature sensor)
Do PWM and analogWrite (LED brightness control)

learning_outcomes.description: Be able to Read Data from Sensors

performance_criteria.description: Interface with temperature sensors (DS1820, DHT11/22 etc.)
Work with light sensors (APDS9960, LDR etc.)
Use motion sensors (RADAR, PIR etc.)

learning_outcomes.description: Be able to Control Actuators

performance_criteria.description: Control a DC motor with Unity Board (Arduino-compatible)
Perform Servo, stepper, DC motors control
Perform Relay operation to control external devices

learning_outcomes.description: Design a Project: Smart Lighting System

performance_criteria.description: Define the project objective, (like remote controlled, motion detection, etc.)
Determine the functional and non-functional requirements for the project
Implement a system that adjusts lighting based on environmental conditions (light sensor + LED)

learning_outcomes.description: Know Communication Protocols

performance_criteria.description: Identify types of communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART)
Explain protocol characteristics and Use cases
Configure basic communication using protocols like MQTT, HTTP, or CoAP in a simulated or real-world environment

learning_outcomes.description: Know Serial Communication

performance_criteria.description: Explain serial communication (UART)
Send and receive data using the serial monitor
Configure UART, I2C, and SPI settings such as baud rate, address setting, and data format in microcontroller environments (e.g., Arduino, Raspberry Pi).

learning_outcomes.description: Understand I2C and SPI Communication

performance_criteria.description: Explains how data transmission occurs in I2C
Interface I2C devices (e.g., LCD display, sensor modules)
Use SPI communication

learning_outcomes.description: Know IoT Networking fundamentals

performance_criteria.description: Evaluate IoT networking to select most suitable for projects (GSM/GPRS, WiFi, Bluetooth, LoRa, etc.)
Explain IP addresses and network protocols
Comprehend the role of IP (Internet Protocol) addresses, MAC addresses, and subnet masks in device identification and communication

learning_outcomes.description: Connect Unity Board(Arduino-compatible) to the Internet

performance_criteria.description: Use a WiFi module (ESP8266/ESP32) with Unity Board(Arduino-compatible)
Do Basic WiFi configuration and connection
Send data to the cloud using HTTP requests

learning_outcomes.description: Design a Project: IoT Temperature Monitor

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate ability to plan for IoT temperature monitor project
Define the functional and nonfunctional requirements of the project
Build a temperature monitoring system that sends data to a cloud platform or web server

learning_outcomes.description: Know Cloud Platforms

performance_criteria.description: Explain cloud platforms in IoT
Identify popular cloud platforms (ThingSpeak, Blynk, AWS IoT,Azure etc.)
Distinguish the strength and best fit of the platforms

learning_outcomes.description: Learn Data Logging on ThingSpeak

performance_criteria.description: Set up a ThingSpeak account
Send sensor data to ThingSpeak using HTTP requests
Visual data in real-time using cloud platforms

learning_outcomes.description: Design a Project: Smart Home Dashboard

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate ability to plan for simple smart home project
Specify function and nonfunctional requirements for the project
Create a dashboard to monitor multiple sensors (temperature, humidity) via ThingSpeak or Blynk

learning_outcomes.description: Know IoT Security

performance_criteria.description: Define IoT security and explain why it is critical in the context of connected devices
Describe the unique security challenges faced by IoT devices, including resource constraints, scalability, and heterogeneity
Explain best practices for securing IoT devices

learning_outcomes.description: Implement Data Encryption

performance_criteria.description: Explain and implement data encryption for IoT devices and authentication measures.
Implement secure communication using HTTPS
Configure secure boot settings to ensure only authenticated firmware runs on a device
understand the role of patches in maintaining security

learning_outcomes.description: Design and Implement Security Solutions for IoT Systems

performance_criteria.description: Build a secure IoT system that encrypts sensor data before sending it to the cloud
Integrate security gateways and edge devices to filter data, enforce policies, and reduce exposure to threats
Secure cloud connections using API keys, certificates, and robust authentication methods

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Regulatory Compliance and Security Standards in IoT

performance_criteria.description: Identify relevant security standards and regulations that apply to IoT systems, such as NDPR/GDPRA for data privacy and ISO/IEC 27001 for information security management
Demonstrate how to implement best practices aligned with NIST Cyber security Framework in IoT environments
Develop compliance checklists for IoT devices and systems to ensure adherence to required security standards
